name: Perenti Limited
summary: Perenti Limited operates as a mining services company worldwide. It operates through the Contract Mining and Drilling Services segments. The company offers underground and surface contract mining, as well as technical services. It also provides drilling services, including specialized deep hole multi-intersectional directional diamond core drilling, underground diamond core drilling, drilling and blasting, and in-pit grade control services. The company was formerly known as Perenti Global Limited and changed its name to Perenti Limited in October 2022. Perenti Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Northbridge, Australia.
